preconditions.description: The number of people n must be between 1 and 200.
The number of friendships m must be between n-1 and 2000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= i <= n and 1 <= j <= n and i != j for i, j, b in friendships)
preconditions.description: Each friendship must involve distinct people within the range of 1 to n.

preconditions.expression: all(b in {0, 1} for i, j, b in friendships)
preconditions.description: The envy direction b must be either 0 or 1.

postconditions.description: The output must be either 'YES' or 'NO' indicating the possibility of a capitalist society.

postconditions.expression: if stdout == 'YES': max_income_inequality = max(a_i) - min(a_i); stdout == str(max_income_inequality)
postconditions.description: If the society is possible, the output must include the maximum income inequality.

postconditions.expression: if stdout == 'YES': all(0 <= a_i <= 10**6 for a_i in incomes)
postconditions.description: If the society is possible, all incomes must be within the range of 0 to 1,000,000.
